steps.name: Jio Customer Care
steps.channel: Toll-free 199 (for Jio numbers), 1800 889 9999 (for non-Jio numbers), or 'Chat with us' via the official website.
steps.when_to_use: For initial complaints regarding unauthorized plan activation and balance deduction.

steps.name: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI)
steps.channel: Grievance Redressal Mechanism via the official website.
steps.when_to_use: If the grievance is not resolved by the service provider.

steps.name: National Consumer Helpline (NCH)
steps.when_to_use: If the issue persists after exhausting company and regulatory channels.

note: The RBI clauses provided are specific to banking and electronic banking transactions and do not apply to this telecom complaint. The Nodal Officer details provided in the sources are explicitly for disaster management and should not be used for general billing complaints.
